financialPrivacy: [XX-Other people see the shared expense and split. They do not see your accounts, categories, payees or bank records.-XX]
fileHelp: [XX-Add tickets, bookings or photos here, even before you have an expense. Files on individual expenses appear here too.-XX]

personHelp: [XX-Keep the same person across groups and optionally link them to a payee. Groups stay separate.-XX]
noPeopleHelp: [XX-Save a person here, then link their appearances in your groups.-XX]

uploadHint: [XX-Files will be shared with the group when you choose Upload.-XX]

detachedCopyHelp: [XX-This is your independent copy from a backup. The original group and its members are separate.-XX]
unlinkConfirm: [XX-Remove this private booking and restore the original bank movement? The shared entry and other participants’ finances will stay as they are.-XX]

fileLinkFailed: [XX-The expense is saved. The file is still in the group’s Files. Retry attaching it without creating another expense.-XX]
contributionPart: [XX-Part of my contribution covered by this payment-XX]

ownContextOnly: [XX-Shared expenses belong to your own profile. Switch back to your profile to view your groups.-XX]
bankStartHelp: [XX-Choose a group, then create an expense or match one already recorded.-XX]
bankPrivacyHelp: [XX-Your account, category and private attachments are visible only to you. Review the expense before sharing it with the group.-XX]
bankNotEligible: [XX-Choose an unreconciled payment from your own open bank or cash account. Category-only splits are supported; transfers and investment entries are not.-XX]

reviewCurrent: [XX-No changes to accepted entries need review.-XX]
reviewEmpty: [XX-No groups included in your finances yet.-XX]
contributionsMismatch: [XX-The amounts paid or received must add up to the amount above.-XX]
selectPeople: [XX-Choose at least one person for this split.-XX]
repaymentExplanation: [XX-Suggestions use everyone’s net balance. You may repay someone who did not pay for your particular expense.-XX]
groupOnlyHelp: [XX-Optional: leave this off to keep the entry only in the group.-XX]
noBankPaymentHelp: [XX-You did not pay or receive money for this entry. Only your share and the amount owed will be recorded.-XX]
saveAndShareHelp: [XX-Save this transaction, then choose a group and split it with people.-XX]

entryUploadHint: [XX-These files will be shared with the group when you save the expense.-XX]

Clear a fixed field to share the remainder again. Relative shares compare portions, such as 2, 1 and 1. Percentage readouts may be rounded; final amounts come from the server.-XX]
